name: Triage a seeded convention and open the create-skill modal
description: From the app root, navigate to Skills Lab > Conventions for the seeded repo, accept one of the three seeded convention candidates, and confirm the toolbar counter updates and the create-skill modal opens pre-filled. Exercises the repo-scoped conventions route, the accept action and the skill-draft fetch. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: land on the PR list so a repo is active

cmd: Configuration is read once into a typed config object
steps.label: seeded convention card is visible
the draft is pre-filled from the accepted convention
back on the list with triage intact
